description: Settings of the job placement policy (applications/ops-placement, scripts/coreweave/placement.py). mode: crisp (default), nl or shadow; NATLANG_CW_PLACEMENT overrides it, --mode overrides both. server/model: the OpenAI-compatible endpoint for nl/shadow. weekly_budget_usd and gpu_hour_price_usd stay null until the owner sets a budget and CoreWeave quotes the GPU rate (with a budget set and no GPU rate, GPU jobs are not placed on CoreWeave).
